items.title: Tetairoa McMillan (foot) was limited in Friday’s practice.
items.text: McMillan was not spotted on Thursday, so this is a good sign for his chances of suiting up on Monday Night Football against the Buccaneers. Still, there’s a non-zero chance he winds up with a questionable tag on Saturday. - Rivers McCown

items.title: Taliese Fuaga (knee) is questionable to play in Week 12 against the Bengals.
items.text: While Fuaga, the Saints’ right tackle, may or may not play, the team’s starting center, Erik McCoy (biceps), will make his return. Getting him back is good news for the Saints’ offense as a whole. Backup OT Asim Richards (knee) is also questionable. - Nic Bodiford

items.title: Vikings coach Kevin O’Connell said Kyler Murray will back up Kirk Cousins in Week 12.
items.text: Murray was removed from the injury report on Friday and will be active for the first time since suffering his hamstring strain. Carson Wentz will likely be an inactive third quarterback. - Rivers McCown

items.title: Noah Fant (calf) is questionable to play in Week 12 against the Bengals.
items.text: With Juwan Johnson (hamstring) sidelined, Fant had a chance to increase his role on Sunday. Getting hurt on Friday pretty much takes him off the TE2 radar. Jordyn Tyson could benefit as a go-to receiver in the short-to-intermediate area of the field. - Nic Bodiford

items.title: Christian Darrisaw (shoulder) will not play in Minnesota’s Week 12 game against the Falcons.
items.text: At no point did he practice after leaving Week 11’s game in Mexico City with the shoulder injury. Ryan Van Demark replaced Darrisaw in mop-up duty and would seem likely to start this week. - Rivers McCown

items.title: Jordan Addison (thumb) will not play in Minnesota’s Week 12 game against the Falcons.
items.text: It’s his third straight absence. Kevin O’Connell seemed optimistic that Addison would have more of a shot to play this week, but he remains practiceless since suffering the thumb injury in a Friday practice ahead of Week 10. - Rivers McCown

items.title: Juwan Johnson (hamstring) will not play in New Orleans’ Week 12 game against the Bengals.
items.text: Perhaps this will give Kellen Moore an excuse to actually get Jordyn Tyson on the field this week. Noah Fant should also benefit from Johnson’s absence, and has a non-zero chance of a TE1 fantasy day given the Bengals strong track record of letting tight ends run wild under DC Al Golden. - Rivers McCown

items.title: Ravens ruled out Vega Ioane (hand) for Week 12 against the Texans.
items.text: The Ravens’ stud rookie right guard has had unfortunate injury luck thus far. He was already playing through knee and shoulder injuries when he injured his hand in yesterday’s practice. Perhaps the time off will help the other two issues heal. The Ravens also ruled out DT Nnamdi Madubuike and S Jaylinn Hawkins. - Nic Bodiford

items.title: Woody Marks cleared the NFL’s concussion protocol and will play in Week 12 against the Ravens.
items.text: Marks will return for No. 2 running back duties after a one-game absence. With zero teams on bye, Marks makes for a shaky FLEX option. He was unable to produce reliably while operating as the team’s starter, and should mostly be viewed as a bench stash at this time. - Nic Bodiford

items.title: Commanders coach Dan Quinn said Brandon Aiyuk will not be elevated from the practice squad for Washington’s Week 12 game against the Cardinals.
items.text: No surprise or shame there — Aiyuk literally just signed on Wednesday. We are curious to see if he’ll be able to get active for Week 13, when the Commanders have a tasty matchup against the Jeffrey Simmons-less Titans. - Rivers McCown
